title: Instant Scribe Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating Instant Scribe application configuration

hotkey.description: Global hotkey combination for start/stop recording

model_hotkey.description: Global hotkey combination for unload/reload model (VRAM management)

pause_hotkey.description: Global hotkey combination for pause/resume recording

vram_overlay_hotkey.description: Global hotkey combination for toggling VRAM overlay display

vad_aggressiveness.description: Voice Activity Detection aggressiveness level (0=least aggressive, 3=most aggressive)

silence_threshold_ms.description: Duration of silence in milliseconds that signifies end of utterance

silence_prune_threshold_ms.description: Threshold for pruning long silence segments before transcription (milliseconds)

batch_length_ms.description: Length of audio batches for parallel transcription processing (milliseconds)

batch_overlap_ms.description: Overlap between audio batches to ensure continuity (milliseconds)

show_notifications.description: Whether to show Windows toast notifications for transcription results

copy_to_clipboard_on_click.description: Whether to copy transcription text to clipboard when notification is clicked

archive_root.description: Root directory path for storing transcription archives (supports environment variables)

paused.description: Current pause state of the application (persisted between sessions)

spooler_chunk_interval_sec.description: Interval in seconds for writing audio chunks to disk during recording

vram_unload_threshold_mb.description: Free VRAM threshold in MB below which model is automatically unloaded

gpu_monitor_interval_sec.description: Polling interval in seconds for GPU resource monitoring

enable_agc.description: Enable Automatic Gain Control for audio enhancement

enable_noise_suppression.description: Enable noise suppression for audio enhancement

telemetry_enabled.description: Enable optional runtime metrics collection (opt-out by default)

high_contrast_icons.description: Use high-contrast icon variants for accessibility

dpi_check_interval_sec.description: Interval in seconds for checking DPI changes on multi-monitor setups
